name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 26 – Am 67
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 26a. Recalls that the former Commissioner responsible for negotiating the anti-corruption framework and the rule of law with Member States during the past five years is now under criminal investigation for money laundering and other corruption-related crimes; condemns the use of rule of law conditionality for politically motivated ideological attacks on Member States; highlights that in these attacks the Commission used NGOs and leftist media outlets and financed them from EU funds; demands therefore that these attacks against national sovereignty misusing the rule of law conditionality be stopped;
